question: The length and breadth of a rectangle are 35 cm and 12 cm, respectively. What will be the circumference of the circle that circumscribes this rectangle? (take π=(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The length and breadth of a rectangle are 35 cm and 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Diagonal of rectangle(d)² = (l)² + (b)²

Circumference of circle = 2πr

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd92f989e69d5317a9351fa6565a6acf58140c3d4150b153e63d8a0a37f77d17.png] 

Length = 35 cm and Breadth = 12 cm

Diagonal of rectangle (d)² = (l)2 + (b)²

⇒ (35² + 12²)

⇒ (1225 + 144) cm²

⇒ √1369 cm²

⇒ d = 37 cm

Now,

Diagonal of rectangle = Diameter of the circle = 37 cm

Radius = 37/2 cm

Now,

Circumference of circle = (2 × 22/7 × 37/2) cm

⇒ (814/7) cm

⇒ 116(2)/(7)cm

**∴ The circumference of the circle is 116(2)/(7)**
